title: Freema
tagline: Freema is a crypto-enabled C2C marketplace operating on Telegram, leveraging chatGPT and Account Abstraction to enhance user experience.
description:
- Telegram Integration : Through the Telegram mini-app, sellers can easily list items by sending images in a chat. Prices are automatically determined by ChatGPT.

- Easy Payments : Buyers can select products via the Telegram mini-app and make payments using existing cryptocurrencies or smoothly transition to crypto via Unlimit.

- Gas-Free Transactions : Utilizing ERC4337 Account Abstraction wallets allows for SNS login and transactions without gas fees.

-  Secure Transactions : Payments from buyers to sellers are securely processed through smart contracts on Base or Mantle, minimizing dependence on operator trust.

- Enhanced Trust : A World ID-based rating system prevents manipulation and rating resets, enhancing marketplace trust in a decentralized manner.
how_its_made:
## Tech Stack

- Frontend : NextJS.
- Backend :  Grammy. (telegram bot chat bot language)
- Conversational Interface : ChatGPT
- Account Management : Implements World ID to prevent a single person from creating multiple accounts.
- Crypto On-ramping : Unlimit.
- Blockchain : Base Sepolia and Mantle Sepolia.
- Account Abstraction Wallet : Kernel Wallet from Zerodev
- Bundler and Paymaster :   ZeroDev on Base and Particle Network on Mantle.
